name: CDC Hume 4 (HU4)

address.note: address used by CDC/DCM/PeeringDB for Hume Campus Two; the ACT cadastre lists the campus block (Block 103 Section 7 Hume, 32,893 sqm) as 5 Tralee Street (source 7)

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '7 Tralee Street, Hume ACT 2620' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100). 5 Tralee St geocodes to the same point.

builder.note: 'Hume Campus Two - H4': delivery model Construction Management; Hindmarsh delivered the building structure while CDC procured major plant and engaged M&E contractors directly

mw_it.note: Infratil Feb 2022 (master.csv lead, not re-accessed; infratil.com returns 403). Hindmarsh project page gives '25MW total capacity' (source 2). CDC lists Hume Campus Two (HU4+HU5) at 51 MW operating (source 5)

cost_aud_m.note: Hindmarsh project page lists 'Value $75M' (corrects earlier $100m snippet) - construction-management value, excludes CDC-procured plant/M&E; not total capex

pathway.value: Development application (ACT Planning and Development Act 2007)

reference.note: probable, not confirmed: ACT completed-DA register shows DA 201732336 on Blocks 42, 43 and 103 Sec 7 Hume (consolidation into Block 103 = 5 Tralee St; subclasses commercial, industrial, design and siting, lease variation, clause changes); timing matches HU4 construction start 2018. A later DA 201834342 (lodged 2018-09-03, approved 2018-11-05, Blocks 103/104) may be an amendment or another building. Proposal text not retrieved

construction_start.note: CDC About us timeline: '2018 New Hume campus HU4 construction begins'; Infratil Oct 2019 presentation also says 2018 (source 3, snippet)

construction_end.note: Infratil Oct 2019 presentation: completion November 2019 (search snippet; likely a forecast at the time); Baxtel says opened 2020

open_questions: cost is builder's CM value only
